Why is it some gifs run like garbage on mobile but I can stream video In 1080p
GIFs paint an entire frame at a time, but streaming video is updating the parts that change and not entire frames of the video. There might be bandwidth issues on the hosting site, too.

Because you have a hardware decoder for the most common video format (h264) but not one for gif. This means your pathetic excuse for a CPU chugs along decoding and rendering the gif. Alternatively the gif you're looking at is not a gif but a crappy video embed using a video format you do not have a hardware decoder for (hevc or vp9) which also then uses a software fallback.
Even on high end gaming pcs with fast internet people have the same issue.
